Confirmed contract: (a) /api/strategy/registry returns 11 strategies including all 8 declarative keys (ema-cross, supertrend, rsi-momentum, macd-trend, bollinger-mr, donchian-breakout, atr-breakout, keltner-breakout), each with params schema; (b) /api/strategy/ema-cross/schema exposes ema_fast, ema_slow, normal_lot_usd, stop_loss_pct as params; (c) /api/strategy/metrics — ema-cross/supertrend/rsi-momentum default enabled=true+status=PAPER; other 5 default enabled=false+status=DISABLED; (d) /api/library returns the 8 with wireable=true and engine_key matching (supertrend.engine_key='supertrend', etc.); (e) PUT /api/strategy/macd-trend/state {enabled:true,status:'PAPER'} flips both fields correctly and reverting to {enabled:false,status:'DISABLED'} restores baseline; (f) full per-strategy config lifecycle for ema-cross: POST configs {params:{ema_fast:5,ema_slow:20,normal_lot_usd:50}} → PUT validation_status=passed → POST activate returns applied_params containing normal_lot_usd + ignored_account_level list; /strategy/ema-cross/effective flips using_config true→false via deactivate; DELETE config succeeds; (g) POST /api/cycle/run/BTC, /ETH, /SOL each return HTTP 200 with the 3 default declarative strategies enabled — no server tracebacks in backend logs (declarative execution path exercised even when no signal fires). minor.issue: Response payload only echoes fields present in the input (e.g. {key,enabled}) — omits status when only enabled provided. Not a bug per se, but the returned object is not a full state snapshot; clients must re-fetch /strategy/metrics to see current status. Consider returning the merged state document for symmetry.

It is possible for a strategy to end up with enabled=true but status='DISABLED' if state is toggled inconsistently (observed macd-trend in this state as residual from prior test runs). PUT accepts partial updates; there is no server-side invariant enforcing that status='DISABLED' implies enabled=false (or vice-versa). Recommend a normalisation guard in strategy_set_state.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> element in Sort dropdown (StrategyCenter:216). Non-blocking but pollutes console. Cause is likely a Visual Editing wrapper injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside option text — verify StrategyLeaderboard.jsx sort <option> rendering.

(LOW) Make PUT /api/strategy/{key}/state response return the full state document (key+enabled+status) rather than only-fields-provided — improves client symmetry.
(LOW) Investigate <span> inside <option> hydration warning in StrategyCenter.jsx:216 sort dropdown (likely Emergent Visual Editing wrapper). Not user-visible but noisy in console.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter38 Phase B declarative engine is contract-complete end-to-end. Use tests/test_iter38_declarative_engine_http.py (9 tests, ~9s, calls /api/cycle/run/BTC once) as regression. Key contract details for future testers: (1) PUT /api/strategy/{key}/state field name is 'status' (not 'mode') — 'status' must be one of LIVE/PAPER/DISABLED/TESTING/OPTIMIZING/ERROR; (2) /api/strategy/metrics returns {'metrics': {key: {...}}} where metrics is a dict keyed by strategy key (not a list); (3) POST /api/strategy/configs returns {'config': {...}} nested; (4) /api/strategy/ema-cross/schema returns {'params': [{id,label,type,default,...}]} list of param specs — check by 'id' field. Do NOT run cycle/run more than 1-2 times per session (rate-limited via ccxt). Always cleanup any TEST_ configs after use.
